name: smwmusic-mario-is-missing-nes-sydney-australia
title: Mario is Missing! (NES) - Sydney Australia
description:
Another famous tune from the old Mario is Missing! for the NES.

Can be used in friendly, upbeat levels as well as happy environments. Could suit 8-bit levels too.

Huge thanks to brickblock369 for helping with the ADSR.
Without him the song wouldn't sound as good ;P

Notable people that helped with the song:
mish1
7 up

Update: Minor Optimizations, Added another Version, togglable inside the .txt file by changing the Version number.
V1 being a more waltzy march styled song, while V2 is a more general bouncy feeling song that could best fit switch palaces.

Lots of love, S1Z2 <3
